<![CDATA[import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

// The live route and download share the original self-contained document.
export function GET() {
  const html = readFileSync(path.join(process.cwd(), "public", "downloads", "nema.html"), "utf8");
  return new Response(html, { headers: { "Content-Type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" } });
}
]]>

button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--sage)}.collection-vertical{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.15em;writing-mode:vertical-rl;position:absolute;bottom:4%;left:8%;color:#aa9da5}
/* Map chapter */
.project-map{padding:135px 0 120px;background:#f8f2ea;position:relative}.map-heading{display:flex;align-items:end;justify-content:space-between;gap:40px}.map-heading h2{max-width:790px;margin:19px 0 0}.map-heading>p{max-width:320px;color:#807583;font-size:13px;line-height:1.8}.map-stage{position:relative;margin-top:64px;height:390px;background:#f2e8e4;border:1px solid #e2d4d6;border-radius:15px;overflow:hidden}.map-stage svg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%}.map-line{fill:none;stroke:#ad93ab;stroke-width:1.5;stroke-dasharray:5 7}.map-line.active{stroke:#e67c61;stroke-width:3;stroke-dasharray:none;stroke-dashoffset:0}.map-point{position:absolute;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);z-index:2}.map-point:nth-of-type(1){left:14%}.map-point:nth-of-type(2){left:38%}.map-point:nth-of-type(3){left:63%}.map-point:nth-of-type(4){left:87%}.map-point button{display:grid;place-items:center;width:77px;height:77px;border:1px solid #d5b7b3;border-radius:50%;background:#fffaf5;color:var(--ink);font:italic 24px Georgia,serif;box-shadow:0 10px 24px #342d460f;transition:transform .4s var(--ease),background .4s,color .4s}.map-point button.active,.map-point button:hover{background:var(--ink);color:white;transform:scale(1.12)}.map-point .map-label{display:block;text-align:center;margin-top:19px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700}.map-point .map-sub{display:block;text-align:center;margin-top:5px;font-size:10px;color:#978b98}.map-feedback{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:30px;align-items:center;border-bottom:1px solid #ddcfd1;padding:27px 0}.map-feedback strong{font:italic 27px Georgia,serif;font-weight:400}.map-feedback p{max-width:550px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.7;color:#8b7d8a}
/* Use-cases horizontal slips */
.prompts-section{background:#e8dce6;padding:110px 0 127px}.prompts-header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:40px;align-items:end;margin-bottom:48px}.prompts-header h2{font-size:clamp(42px,5vw,75px);font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.075em;line-height:1.08;margin:18px 0 0;max-width:650px}.prompts-header p{font-size:12px;color:#786b78;max-width:290px;line-height:1.7}.prompt-slips{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:15px;align-items:stretch}.prompt-slip{min-height:260px;text-align:left;border:1px solid #dfcfdc;padding:27px 25px;background:#fbf7f2;border-radius:7px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;transition:transform .5s var(--ease),box-shadow .4s;background-position:center}.prompt-slip:nth-child(2){background:#d4e0d4;transform:translateY(22px)}.prompt-slip:nth-child(3){background:#f6dcca;transform:translateY(-14px)}.prompt-slip:nth-child(4){background:#d7d1e7;transform:translateY(13px)}.prompt-slip:hover{transform:translateY(-12px) rotate(-1deg);box-shadow:0 19px 38px #342d4627}.prompt-slip .n{font:10px 'Courier New',monospace}.prompt-slip p{font:italic 28px Georgia,serif;line-height:1.15;margin:25px 0}.prompt-slip .action{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;display:flex;justify-content:space-between}
/* Pricing rows, no standard cards */
.pricing{padding:135px 0 160px}.pricing-heading{display:flex;align-items:end;justify-content:space-between;gap:35px;margin-bottom:50px}.pricing h2{margin:18px 0 0}.pricing-heading p{max-width:320px;color:var(--ink-light);font-size:13px;line-height:1.7}.plan-list{border-top:1px solid #cfc2c7}.plan-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.14fr .98fr .7fr .35fr;align-items:center;gap:30px;padding:35px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #cfc2c7;transition:padding .35s,background .35s}.plan-row:hover{padding-inline:14px;background:#f4e9e6}.plan-row .n{font:11px 'Courier New',monospace;color:var(--coral)}.plan-row h3{font-size:39px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.065em;margin:0 0 8px}.plan-row p{color:var(--ink-light);font-size:12px;line-height:1.7;margin:0;max-width:280px}.plan-row .price{font:32px Georgia,serif}.plan-row .price small{font:11px Arial,sans-serif;color:#92818f}.plan-row .round-btn{justify-self:end}.pricing-footnote{font-size:10px;color:#938691;margin-top:18px}
/* FAQ airy editorial */
.faq{padding:0 0 160px}.faq-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.7fr 1.3fr;gap:12%}.faq h2{font-size:clamp(44px,5vw,77px);font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.075em;margin:0}.faq h2 .serif{color:var(--coral)}.faq-accordion{border-top:1px solid #d6c9cf}.faq-item{border-bottom:1px solid #d6c9cf}.faq-item button{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;width:100%;text-align:left;padding:22px 0;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--ink);font-size:14px;font-weight:600}.faq-item button span:last-child{font-size:23px;font-weight:300;transition:transform .3s}.faq-item button[aria-expanded=true] span:last-child{transform:rotate(45deg);color:var(--coral)}.faq-answer{max-height:0;overflow:hidden;transition:max-height .5s var(--ease)}.faq-answer p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.85;color:var(--ink-light);max-width:550px;margin:0;padding:0 35px 23px 0}
/* CTA footer: original shape, no giant wordmark */
.final-section{background:#e67c61;color:#342d46;position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:135px 0 25px}.final-section:before{content:'✳';position:absolute;top:-250px;right:-100px;font-size:710px;font-weight:200;line-height:1;color:#fff7ec1c;transform:rotate(-21deg);pointer-events:none}.final-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;align-items:end;gap:12%;position:relative;z-index:1}.final-grid h2{font-weight:500;font-size:clamp(64px,8.8vw,148px);line-height:.92;letter-spacing:-.085em;margin:18px 0 0}.final-grid h2 .serif{color:#fff3e7}.final-right{padding-bottom:10px}.final-right p{font-size:17px;line-height:1.6;max-width:370px;margin:0 0 31px}.final-note{margin-top:23px;font-size:11px;max-width:430px;line-height:1.7;opacity:.75}.final-form{display:flex;gap:8px;max-width:480px;border-bottom:1px solid #342d4666;padding-bottom:10px}.final-form input{background:transparent;border:0;outline:none!important;padding:12px 5px;min-width:0;flex:1;color:var(--ink);font-size:13px}.final-form input::placeholder{color:#533d49aa}.final-form button{background:var(--ink);color:white;border:0;border-radius:100px;padding:0 18px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;transition:transform .3s,background .3s}.final-form button:hover{background:#f8f2ea;color:var(--ink);transform:translateY(-3px)}.final-feedback{min-height:26px;margin-top:14px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700}.site-footer{border-top:1px solid #342d4655;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;margin-top:116px;padding:25px 0 0;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.05em}.site-footer a{border-bottom:1px solid transparent;padding-bottom:3px;transition:border-color .25s}.site-footer a:hover{border-color:var(--ink)}.footer-links{display:flex;gap:25px}
/* Modal */
.dialog-backdrop{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#17131dbb;backdrop-filter:blur(7px);z-index:1000;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:25px}.dialog-backdrop.open{display:flex}.dialog{background:#fffaf6;border-radius:16px;width:min(900px,100%);max-height:90vh;overflow:auto;position:relative;box-shadow:0 35px 90px #0005}.dialog-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;min-height:440px}.dialog-visual{min-height:300px}.dialog-info{padding:58px 44px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:start;justify-content:center}.dialog-info h2{font-weight:500;font-size:clamp(36px,4vw,60px);letter-spacing:-.065em;line-height:1.05;margin:20px 0}.dialog-info p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.85;color:#7d7080}.dialog-close{position:absolute;right:17px;top:16px;width:35px;height:35px;background:#fffaf6;border:1px solid #dcd2d5;border-radius:50%;z-index:2;font-size:18px;transition:transform .3s}.dialog-close:hover{transform:rotate(90deg);background:var(--sage)}.dialog-info .round-btn{margin-top:20px}
/* Motion */
.js .reveal:not(.in-view){opacity:0;transform:translateY(35px)}.reveal{transition:opacity .8s var(--ease),transform .95s var(--ease)}.reveal.in-view{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}.js .hero .hero-copy{animation:heroEnter 1.1s .05s both var(--ease)}.js .hero .conversation-shell{animation:chatEnter 1.15s .15s both var(--ease)}.js .hero .hero-bottom{animation:heroEnter 1s .6s both var(--ease)}.image-tilt{transition:transform .45s var(--ease)}.image-tilt:hover{transform:translateY(-5px) rotate(.5deg)}.pop{animation:pop .35s var(--ease)}
@keyframes heroEnter{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(35px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}@keyframes chatEnter{from{opacity:0;transform:translate(15px,35px) scale(.98)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}@keyframes floatSticker{50%{transform:translateY(-12px) rotate(-5deg)}}@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}@keyframes ticker{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}@keyframes pop{0%{transform:scale(.96);opacity:.55}100%{transform:scale(1);opacity:1}}

/* Final interaction polish: no browser-default button frame and a gapless marquee */
.text-link{appearance:none;background:transparent;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid currentColor;color:var(--ink);padding:0 0 7px;}
.ticker-track{gap:0}
.ticker-group{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:48px;padding-right:48px;flex:none}
@media(max-width:620px){.canvas-tools{top:52px}}

/* NEMA CLOUDSCAPE EDITION — original user-provided hero/footer artwork.
   Both textures embedded to keep this HTML fully standalone. */
.hero{
  background-color:#f8f2ea;
  background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(248,242,234,.33) 0%,rgba(248,242,234,.08) 47%,rgba(248,242,234,.05) 100%),url("data:image/webp;base64,");
  background-repeat:no-repeat;
  background-size:cover;
  background-position:center center;
}
/* Retain legibility while letting the real watercolor pigment show through. */
.hero::before{
  opacity:.10;
  background-image:radial-gradient(#342d4630 .6px,transparent .6px);
  background-size:24px 24px;
}
/* Remove the previous oversized decorative asterisk: the cloud artwork is the composition. */
.final-section::before{content:none}
.final-grid h2 .serif{color:#ba695e}
.site-footer{border-top-color:rgba(52,45,70,.35)}
@media (max-width:860px){
  .hero{background-position:55% center}
  
}
@media (max-width:620px){
  .hero{background-position:51% center;background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(248,242,234,.17),rgba(248,242,234,.10)),url("data:image/webp;base64,")}
  
  .final-grid h2 .serif{color:#b9605d}
}

/* NEMA footer: transparent watercolor art with intrinsic aspect ratio.
   It scales by width, never uses cover/height limits, and can never be cropped. */
.final-section{
  background:#fff;
  background-image:none;
  position:relative;
  isolation:isolate;
  overflow:hidden;
}
.final-section > .footer-cloud-art{
  display:block;
  position:absolute;
  left:0;
  bottom:0;
  width:100%;
  height:auto;
  max-width:none;
  max-height:none;
  object-fit:initial;
  opacity:1;
  z-index:0;
  pointer-events:none;
  user-select:none;
}
.final-section > .container{position:relative;z-index:1}
.final-section::before{content:none}
</style>

<body>
<div class="scroll-line" id="scrollProgress" aria-hidden="true"></div>
<header class="site-header" id="top"><div class="header-inner"><a class="brand" href="#top" aria-label="NEMA, back to top"><span class="asterisk">✳</span>nema<span style="color:var(--coral)">.</span></a><nav class="header-center" id="siteNav" aria-label="Main navigation"><a href="#how">How it works</a><a href="#canvas">Canvas</a><a href="#research">Research</a><a href="#plans">Plans</a></nav><div class="header-actions"><span class="tiny">Made for curious minds</span><a class="round-btn" href="#conversation">Explore NEMA <svg class="arrow-icon" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none"><path d="M4 16 16 4M6 4h10v10" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"/></svg></a><button class="nav-toggle" id="navToggle" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="siteNav" aria-label="Open navigation">☰</button></div></div></header>
<main>
<section class="hero" id="conversation"><div class="container hero-layout">
 <div class="hero-copy"><div class="hero-eyebrow eyebrow"><span class="dash"></span>AI FOR THE WAY IDEAS REALLY HAPPEN</div><h1>Make room<br>for <span class="serif">what if.</span></h1><p class="hero-desc">The best ideas rarely arrive fully formed. Meet NEMA—one thoughtful space to explore a question, follow a thread, and make something meaningful.</p><div class="hero-actions"><a href="#canvas" class="round-btn">See what a thought can become <svg class="arrow-icon" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none"><path d="M4 16 16 4M6 4h10v10" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"/></svg></a><button class="text-link" id="focusPrompt" type="button">Try a conversation <svg class="arrow-icon" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none"><path d="M4 16 16 4M6 4h10v10" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"/></svg></button></div><div class="hero-bottom"><span class="circle"></span>ASK · EXPLORE · COLLECT · CREATE <span style="margin-left:10px">[ A WORKSPACE FOR THE WONDERING ]</span></div></div>
 <div class="conversation-shell"><div class="conversation-halo"></div><div class="mini-orbit" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="conversation-window" aria-label="Interactive NEMA illustrative demo"><div class="cw-head"><div class="name"><span class="spark">✳</span> New conversation</div><div class="right"><span class="online"></span> Example workspace <span style="font-size:16px;margin-left:5px">⋯</span></div></div><div class="cw-body" id="conversationBody"><p class="cw-day">A fresh start, whenever you're ready</p><div class="user-msg" id="demoQuestion">Help me explore an identity for a thoughtful new design studio.</div><div class="ai-message"><div class="ai-avatar">✳</div><div class="ai-copy"><div class="byline">NEMA <span style="color:#afa3ad;font-weight:400;margin-left:7px">· illustrative response</span></div><p id="demoAnswer">Let's start with the feeling: warm, grounded, a little unexpected. (() => {
'use strict';
const $=(s,r=document)=>r.querySelector(s), $$=(s,r=document)=>Array.from(r.querySelectorAll(s));

const demos={
 brand:{question:'Help me explore an identity for a thoughtful new design studio.',answer:"Let's start with the feeling: warm, grounded, a little unexpected.  research:{question:'Why do some spaces feel so calm?',answer:"One fascinating direction is the way geometry and daylight interact. };
let currentDemo='brand';
const qs=$('#demoQuestion'), as=$('#demoAnswer'), heroImage=$('#heroImage'), previewTitle=$('#previewTitle'), previewType=$('#previewType');
function swapDemo(key,scroll=false){
 const d=demos[key]||demos.brand;currentDemo=key;
 qs.textContent=d.question;as.textContent=d.answer;heroImage.src=d.img;heroImage.alt=d.alt;previewTitle.textContent=d.title;previewType.textContent=d.type;
 $$('#demoSuggestions button').forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(b.dataset.demo===key)));
 const target=$('#heroOutput');target.classList.remove('pop');void target.offsetWidth;target.classList.add('pop');
 if(scroll){$('#conversation').scrollIntoView({behavior:prefersReduce.matches?'auto':'smooth'});}
}
$$('#demoSuggestions button').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>swapDemo(b.dataset.demo)));
$('#focusPrompt').addEventListener('click',()=>{ $('#conversation').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'});$('#demoInput').focus({preventScroll:true}); });
$('#demoForm').addEventListener('submit',e=>{
 e.preventDefault();const text=$('#demoInput').value.trim();if(!text)return;
 const lower=text.toLowerCase();let key=/travel|trip|coast|vacation|escape/.test(lower)?'travel':/space|research|architecture|reference|light/.test(lower)?'research':'brand';
 swapDemo(key);qs.textContent=text;
 as.textContent=`This is an interactive preview rather than a live AI response. Here's a related example you can explore: ${demos[key].title}`;
 $('#demoInput').value='';$('#conversationBody').scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});
});
// Artifact modal
let previousFocus=null;
function showDialog(img,title,desc,type='A NEMA ARTIFACT'){
 previousFocus=document.activeElement;$('#dialogImage').src=img;$('#dialogTitle').textContent=title;$('#dialogDescription').textContent=desc;$('#dialogType').textContent=type;
 $('#artifactModal').classList.add('open');$('#artifactModal').setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');document.body.style.overflow='hidden';$('#closeDialog').focus();
}
function closeDialog(){ $('#artifactModal').classList.remove('open');$('#artifactModal').setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');document.body.style.overflow='';if(previousFocus&&previousFocus.focus)previousFocus.focus();}
$('#openArtifact').addEventListener('click',()=>{const d=demos[currentDemo];showDialog(d.img,d.dialogTitle,d.dialogDesc,d.type);});
$('#openCanvasArtifact').addEventListener('click',()=>showDialog(IMAGE.brand,'A New Possibility','A sculptural brand direction imagined from a creative conversation. Explore the idea and come back to your work.','BRAND CONCEPT / EXPLORATION'));
$('#closeDialog').addEventListener('click',closeDialog);$('#artifactModal').addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===$('#artifactModal'))closeDialog();});
$('#dialogContinue').addEventListener('click',()=>{closeDialog();$('#conversation').scrollIntoView({behavior:prefersReduce.matches?'auto':'smooth'});});
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'){if($('#artifactModal').classList.contains('open'))closeDialog();if($('#siteNav').classList.contains('open')){$('#siteNav').classList.remove('open');$('#navToggle').setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');$('#navToggle').textContent='☰';}}if(e.key==='Tab'&&$('#artifactModal').classList.contains('open')){const a=$$('button,[href],input,textarea,select,[tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])',$('#artifactModal')).filter(x=>!x.disabled);const first=a[0],last=a[a.length-1];if(e.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===first){e.preventDefault();last.focus()}else if(!e.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===last){e.preventDefault();first.focus()}}});
// Artifact stage selector
const steps=[
 {img:IMAGE.mood,label:'NEMA / EXPLORATION 001',caption:'Where the good ideas gather.',alt:'Material and palette moodboard'},
 {img:IMAGE.brand,label:'NEMA / EXPLORATION 002',caption:'A new direction takes shape.',alt:'Sculptural brand concept objects'},
 {img:IMAGE.mood,label:'NEMA / EXPLORATION 003',caption:'Made from the interesting bits.',alt:'Creative moodboard with carefully considered textures'}
];
$$('[data-step]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{
 const s=steps[Number(b.dataset.step)];$$('[data-step]').forEach(t=>t.classList.toggle('active',t===b));
 const img=$('#artifactImage');img.style.opacity='.2';img.style.transform='scale(1.07)';
 setTimeout(()=>{img.src=s.img;img.alt=s.alt;$('#artifactLabel').textContent=s.label;$('#artifactCaption').textContent=s.caption;img.style.opacity='1';img.style.transform='scale(1)'},prefersReduce.matches?0:180);
}));
// Draggable visual board: pointer capture, constrained inside board, preserve rotation.
const board=$('#workbench');
$$('[data-draggable]').forEach(card=>{
 let dragging=false, startX=0,startY=0,origX=0,origY=0,id=null;
 card.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
  if(e.button!==0)return;dragging=true;id=e.pointerId;startX=e.clientX;startY=e.clientY;origX=Number(card.dataset.dx||0);origY=Number(card.dataset.dy||0);
  card.setPointerCapture(id);card.style.zIndex='8';
 });
 card.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{
  if(!dragging||e.pointerId!==id)return;
  const dx=origX+(e.clientX-startX),dy=origY+(e.clientY-startY);
  const maxX=board.clientWidth*.4,maxY=board.clientHeight*.35;
  const x=Math.max(-maxX,Math.min(maxX,dx)),y=Math.max(-maxY,Math.min(maxY,dy));
  card.dataset.dx=x;card.dataset.dy=y;
  const deg=card.classList.contains('c1')?-7:8;
  card.style.transform=`translate(${x}px,${y}px) rotate(${deg}deg)`;
 });
 function end(e){if(!dragging)return;dragging=false;card.style.zIndex='2';if(card.hasPointerCapture(id))card.releasePointerCapture(id);}
 card.addEventListener('pointerup',end);card.addEventListener('pointercancel',end);
});

function selectMap(i){$$('[data-map]').forEach((b,k)=>b.classList.toggle('active',k===i));$('#mapHeading').textContent=mapData[i][0];$('#mapText').textContent=mapData[i][1];const line=$('#activeMapLine');if(line){const len=line.getTotalLength();line.style.strokeDasharray=`${len}`;line.style.strokeDashoffset=`${len*(1-(i+1)/4)}`;line.style.transition='stroke-dashoffset .9s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)';}}
$$('[data-map]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>selectMap(Number(b.dataset.map))));selectMap(0);
$$('[data-starter]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{swapDemo(b.dataset.starter,true);setTimeout(()=>$('#demoInput').focus({preventScroll:true}),prefersReduce.matches?0:650)}));
// Plans: jump to demo signup, annotate intent locally
$$('.plan-btn').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{$('#early-access').scrollIntoView({behavior:prefersReduce.matches?'auto':'smooth'});$('#earlyFeedback').textContent=`${b.dataset.plan} access selected · concept only`;setTimeout(()=>$('#earlyEmail').focus({preventScroll:true}),prefersReduce.matches?0:500);}));
// FAQs
$$('.faq-item button').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{const opened=btn.getAttribute('aria-expanded')==='true';$$('.faq-item button').forEach(b=>{b.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');b.nextElementSibling.style.maxHeight='0px'});if(!opened){btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');btn.nextElementSibling.style.maxHeight=btn.nextElementSibling.scrollHeight+'px';}}));
// Local form only
$('#earlyForm').addEventListener('submit',e=>{e.preventDefault();const input=$('#earlyEmail'),feedback=$('#earlyFeedback');if(!input.value.trim()||!input.checkValidity()){feedback.textContent='Enter a valid email address to try this demo.';input.focus();return;}feedback.textContent='Looks good! This is a demo—nothing was submitted or saved.';});
// Mobile nav
$('#navToggle').addEventListener('click',()=>{let open=$('#siteNav').classList.toggle('open');$('#navToggle').setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(open));$('#navToggle').textContent=open?'×':'☰';});
$$('#siteNav a').forEach(a=>a.addEventListener('click',()=>{$('#siteNav').classList.remove('open');$('#navToggle').setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');$('#navToggle').textContent='☰';}));
// In-view reveal (starting states declared in critical CSS prior to paint)
const revealObserver='IntersectionObserver' in window?new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{entries.forEach(entry=>{if(entry.isIntersecting){entry.target.classList.add('in-view');revealObserver.unobserve(entry.target);}})},{rootMargin:'0px 0px -5% 0px',threshold:0.04}):null;
$$('.reveal').forEach(el=>{if(revealObserver&&!prefersReduce.matches)revealObserver.observe(el);else el.classList.add('in-view')});
// Native scroll progress, no scroll hijack
let ticking=false;
function onScroll(){if(ticking)return;ticking=true;requestAnimationFrame(()=>{const max=Math.max(1,document.documentElement.scrollHeight-innerHeight);$('#scrollProgress').style.transform=`scaleX(${Math.min(1,scrollY/max)})`;ticking=false;});}
window.addEventListener('scroll',onScroll,{passive:true});onScroll();
// Seamless ticker: each of the two copies is identical. Ensure no gap on wide screens.
const track=$('.ticker-track'),group=$('.ticker-group');const orig=group.innerHTML;
function fitTicker(){if(!track||!group)return;const follower=track.children[1];group.innerHTML=orig;while(group.getBoundingClientRect().width<window.innerWidth*1.2)group.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',orig);follower.innerHTML=group.innerHTML;track.style.animationDuration=(group.getBoundingClientRect().width/45).toFixed(1)+'s';}
fitTicker();let tickerResizeTimer;window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{clearTimeout(tickerResizeTimer);tickerResizeTimer=setTimeout(fitTicker,140)},{passive:true});
})();
</script>
